title: Upholstered furniture brand importing into Los Angeles, with showrooms

input.what: Upholstered furniture brand importing to Los Angeles with showrooms in California and New York

assumptions: The Los Angeles showroom of a brand that imports upholstered furniture made outside the US. The company, tax, city and building filings are those of strict/la-bubble-tea.json and gold/la-food-importer.json (the same city and importer of record); the furniture filings and facts are read from APHIS, EPA, CPSC and BHGS on 2026-10-21. California's importer's license covers selling at retail (Business and Professions Code 19051, in BHGS's law book), so the retail dealer's license must not appear. The New York showroom is its own case (manhattan-upholstered-showroom). Second pass (2026-10-21): the ISF and the bond are read from 19 CFR parts 149 and 142 on GovInfo; SB 54 is conditional (a small producer claims the exemption); the duties and Ohio's registration for brands selling into Ohio are facts on the customs rows.
